query: SELECT count(u.id) AS "calls!", COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(u.prompt_tokens,0)+COALESCE(u.completion_tokens,0)),0)::bigint AS "tokens!", COALESCE($2::timestamptz, e.budget_since) AS since FROM decision_engines e LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.route=$1 AND u.created_at >= COALESCE($2::timestamptz, e.budget_since, '-infinity'::timestamptz) WHERE e.name=$3 GROUP BY e.budget_since
